BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating the tax-me-more account; adding a newsection to chapter 82.32 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Recognizing there are individuals whobelieve they are undertaxed and that advocate a greater tax burden forWashingtonians, it is hereby the declared policy of this state toprovide such individuals with the opportunity to contribute more oftheir income to state government and to this end there is herebycreated in the state treasury the "taxmemore account." Any personwho believes they are undertaxed may contribute any amount of moneythey so choose to the account. The account shall consist of moneyreceived from contributions, donations, gifts, bequests, grants, orother sources granted or given for this account.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The taxmemore account is created in the state treasury. Allreceipts from citizens' voluntary contributions, donations, gifts,bequests, grants, or other sources granted or given for this account p. 1 SB 5700must be deposited in the account. Money in the account may be spentonly after appropriation. Expenditures from the account may be usedfor any general fund or transportation purposes.
